spec.title: The Sunline Archipelago
spec.axes: Blender: X east, Y north, Z up. Runtime: x, z, -y.

navigation.mode: First-person land/boardwalk walking plus swimming and island arrival points; closed building interiors.

inferred_choices: Ten visible landforms derived from reference
Metric dimensions estimated from 19 m train car spacing
Two main shuttle lines and a northeast tunnel branch
Closed exterior architecture, no furnished interiors requested

final_override_precedence.physical_geometry: Tropical_Archipelago.blend contains the final editable terrain, structural geometry, material assignments, walkable surfaces and collider tags.
final_override_precedence.base_spatial_definitions: The existing island, railway, settlement and dock definitions remain the reference-traced design baseline. Local changes recorded below supersede only their named geometry or route.

public_route_records.merge_rule: Merge by id; a record in refined_routes.json replaces the same-id base record in full. Unchanged base records remain in effect.
public_route_records.authority: Final source meshes govern actual walking and collision. Route records define traversal intent and verification paths.
public_route_records.historical_snapshots: Embedded updated_routes or updated_route entries in other refinement reports are historical snapshots; use refined_routes.json for the final route record.

ocean_color.scope: Separate granular coral colonies and adjusted turquoise/sand color; island coastlines, reef shelf extent and transport layout are retained.

acceptance_scope.exploration: Exterior settlement streets, shore approaches, station access, decks, boardwalks and piers, with swimming between reachable coastal areas.
acceptance_scope.buildings: Complete exterior architecture; closed building interiors.
acceptance_scope.reference: The single supplied aerial image is the primary layout and visual target. Hidden facades and metric dimensions are interpreted.

source_gate_check.scope: Nine exact-source capsule probes at the shared Palm shore entry; this local check does not assert full-world traversal.

runtime_navigation_evidence.validity: Only results whose sourceSha256 matches the exported final source apply. Read individual route results; no overall completion is implied by this specification.
